problem: Apple wanted space inside the phone and to move users toward wireless audio.
title: Apple removes the headphone jack from the iPhone 7
context: The iPhone 7 launched without the 3.5mm headphone jack that earlier models had.
decision_made: Remove the headphone jack, include a Lightning adapter and introduce AirPods.
action_taken: Announced the change in September 2016; AirPods began shipping in late October at $159.
observed_outcome: Critics mocked the move and its "courage" framing; some analysts expected it to help wireless headphone sales. Sales data was not found in the sources used.
lessons: Removing a widely used port can draw criticism even when the company frames it as progress.
limitations: Only immediate reaction was documented. AirPods or iPhone 7 sales effects were not checked here.

claims.claim_text: Apple dropped the headphone jack from the iPhone 7 and introduced wireless AirPods.
Commentators criticised the change and the courage framing at the time.
